name: past
description: One memory for every teammate and every agent on a project. Your Codex sessions go in, and each prompt gets what was decided before, with dated sources.

interface.longDescription: Your Codex sessions are read into a past.dev project when they are over, and every session and every prompt start with what past.dev recalls about the project: decisions, the reasons behind them, what was already tried. Only the prompts and the replies are sent, never tool output, file contents or diffs.
defaultPrompt: What did we decide in earlier sessions on this project, and why? Search past.dev.
What was already tried on this project and dropped? Search past.dev before I start.
